what: Detection under the answer-checked rule: three attack sets x four encoders.
read_this_first: The `either` column the paper quotes is the *_joint_eta family: eta_a is fitted on the benign arm, then the DG height is refitted given it so the conjunction spends the whole benign budget. Reading the conjunction at DG's own height understates it.
Answer coverage is 1.00 on both arms of every cell; a cell with partial coverage would degrade toward dg_only and answer_coverage says so.
Benign rates are single-seed holdout draws; the 200-split mean on these arms is near 0.055.
The three attack classes move in different directions and must not be pooled.
note_pairing: Each rate's threshold pairing is recorded per cell in the full artefacts at cpu-server:<server-workdir>/answer_check_20260909/cells/*.json under answer_rules_pairing; this trimmed copy carries the values only.
